name: Sleeping Cat Miniature City
description: A tiny glowing city built on the back of a sleeping giant cat.
prompt: A single adorable surreal image: a giant fluffy cat sleeping peacefully in a meadow, a miniature glowing city with tiny streets, houses, and bridges nestled along its back and tail, warm sunset light, fireflies, soft fur texture, people and tiny vehicles for scale, cozy and magical, ultra-detailed, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: Please do not wake the city. 🐈🌆
